upgrades.title: Quickened Words I
upgrades.description: Add 20% of base phrase frequency. Each phrase keeps its current conviction.

upgrades.title: Compelling Creed I
upgrades.description: Add 0.5 conviction to each phrase. Speaking rhythm stays the same.

upgrades.title: Fleet Footsteps I
upgrades.description: Add 15% of base running speed. Speaking and conviction stay the same.

upgrades.title: Quickened Words II
upgrades.description: Add another 20% of base phrase frequency.

upgrades.title: Compelling Creed II
upgrades.description: Add another 0.5 conviction to each phrase.

upgrades.title: Fleet Footsteps II
upgrades.description: Add another 15% of base running speed.

upgrades.title: Quickened Words III
upgrades.description: Rank 1 adds 20% of base phrase frequency; rank 2 adds 30%. Conviction per phrase stays the same.

upgrades.title: Compelling Creed III
upgrades.description: Each rank adds 0.5 conviction per phrase. Overflow still carries to the next listener.

upgrades.title: Fleet Footsteps III
upgrades.description: Each rank adds 15% of base running speed. Speaking frequency and conviction stay the same.

upgrades.title: Meadow Invitations
upgrades.description: Invite five meadow neighbours. Opens the next talking and running tier.

upgrades.title: Quickened Words IV
upgrades.description: Add 50% of base phrase frequency for a growing audience.

upgrades.title: Fleet Footsteps IV
upgrades.description: Add 30% of base running speed to reach more listeners.

upgrades.title: East Lane Invitations
upgrades.description: Invite five east-lane visitors. Opens the final talking and running tier.

upgrades.title: Quickened Words V
upgrades.description: Add 60% of base phrase frequency. Conviction per phrase stays independent.

upgrades.title: Fleet Footsteps V
upgrades.description: Add 30% of base running speed. Keep choosing your own route.

upgrades.title: Helping Hand
upgrades.description: A helper walks to one listener at a time. Three one-second phrases recruit them; player stat upgrades affect only you.

upgrades.title: Merchant Invitations
upgrades.description: Invite two merchants near the market. Each needs 9 conviction and gives 12 gold.

upgrades.title: Fair Bargain
upgrades.description: Add 1.5 conviction per phrase against merchants.

upgrades.title: Generous Purses
upgrades.description: Each merchant gives 6 extra gold per conversion.

upgrades.title: Trusted Patron
upgrades.description: Add 1.5 more conviction per phrase against merchants.

upgrades.title: Town Debate
upgrades.description: Invite the Skeptic, Guard, Zealot, then Priest, one per round. Convince each in the center to advance.

upgrades.title: Patient Answers
upgrades.description: Add 2 conviction per phrase against the Skeptic.

upgrades.title: Common Ground
upgrades.description: Add 2 conviction per phrase against the Guard, after the two opening objections.

upgrades.title: Gentle Certainty
upgrades.description: Add 3 conviction per phrase against the Zealot. Stay close to retain progress.

upgrades.title: Steady Voice
upgrades.description: Add 1 conviction per phrase against all four opponents.

upgrades.title: Sacred Questions
upgrades.description: Add 3 conviction per phrase against the Priest, after the three opening objections.

upgrades.title: Open Sermon
upgrades.description: Add 2 more conviction per phrase against all opponents.

upgrades.title: Shared Faith
upgrades.description: Add 3 more conviction per phrase against the Priest. Convincing the Priest completes Bramblewick.

upgrades.title: Compelling Creed IV
upgrades.description: Add 1 conviction per phrase for every audience, including merchants and opponents.

upgrades.title: Compelling Creed V
upgrades.description: Add another 1 conviction per phrase for every audience.

upgrades.title: Quickened Words VI
upgrades.description: Add 50% of base phrase frequency for the final debates.

upgrades.title: Fleet Footsteps VI
upgrades.description: Add 20% of base movement speed to reach the plaza and merchants.
